svg.text: Servo SVG Architecture — Full Class Relationship Diagram
Cross-subsystem class relationships spanning Script DOM, Layout, Image Cache, and External libraries
svg_id: String — UUID for cache mapping
→ SVGElement branch: request rasterization, create ImageFragment
Full SVG Data Flow — Round-Trip Across Threads
1. Script creates SVGSVGElement → Layout queries SVGElementData → source=None → queued for serialization
2. Script serializes (SVGSVGElement::serialize_and_cache_subtree) → dirty node → triggers second reflow
3. Layout gets data URL → ImageCache.get_cached_image → VectorImageData parsed via usvg::Tree::from_data()
4. ReplacedContents.svg_kind_size → rasterize_vector_image → thread pool: tiny_skia::Pixmap + resvg::render
